examples:
FROM employees
| STATS count = COUNT(*) BY languages
| SORT languages DESC

ROW n=1
| WHERE n < 0
| STATS COUNT(n)

FROM employees
| STATS
    gte20 = COUNT(*) WHERE height >= 2,
    lte18 = COUNT(*) WHERE height <= 1.8

ROW mv = [1, 2], n = NULL, t = TRUE, f = FALSE
| STATS COUNT(mv), COUNT(n), COUNT(t), COUNT(f)

ROW n=1
| STATS COUNT(n > 0 OR NULL), COUNT(n < 0 OR NULL)

TS exp_histo_sample
| WHERE instance == "instance-0"
| STATS cnt = COUNT(responseTime)

TS histogram_timeseries_index
| WHERE instance == "instance-0"
| STATS cnt = COUNT(responseTime::tdigest)
